annotations.title: Rental offers for one GPU, by tier

description: Rental offers for one GPU type: provider, price in USD per GPU per hour, number of GPUs in the published configuration, billing and region when published. One block per tier (guaranteed, community, spot), each with its own cheapest offer, also given per configuration (cheapest_by_gpu_count: the price per GPU of a single GPU and of a multi-GPU node are not comparable); tiers are never compared with each other. guaranteed: capacity the provider presents as not interrupted; community: third-party hosts; spot: interruptible capacity. Prices are as published by the provider, and dated. Get the GPU id from list_gpus.

detail.description: compact (default): the 3 cheapest offers of each tier. full: up to 50 offers per tier

gpu.description: GPU id from list_gpus, for example h100-sxm-80gb

gpu_count.description: Only this published configuration: 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 GPUs

region.description: Only this region, as published by the provider

tier.description: Only this tier (default: one block per tier)
